$comment: JSON schema for the nautobot_ssot_mongo PLUGINS_CONFIG entry.

mongo_username.description: Username used to authenticate; leave empty if the URI carries credentials or auth is not enforced.

nautobot_role.description: Role of this Nautobot instance. HUB is the single federated instance: it owns and publishes the global catalog and syncs in the inventory of every spoke. SPOKE owns and publishes its inventory (locations, racks, devices, interfaces, VLANs, IP addresses and cables) and mirrors the hub's catalog.

nautobot_instance.description: Value stored in each document's nautobot_instance field; this instance only writes documents carrying this value.

hub_instance.description: nautobot_instance value of the hub. Only used by a spoke, which reads global objects from this partition. Must differ from nautobot_instance on a spoke.

tombstone_ttl_days.description: Days a soft-deleted (tombstone) document is kept before MongoDB expires it through a TTL index. 0 keeps tombstones forever.
